A closed route, several possible compartments

chamber. Artery and vein refer to direction relative to the heart.

Switch the rate, preserve the state

V (3−) = V (3+) = 560 , V (6) = 500 .

pages.title: An exact interval algorithm
pages.text:
An exact interval algorithm
For each constant-rate interval:
∆Vk = (Qin,k − Qout,k)∆tk, V k+1 = Vk + ∆Vk.
Reject an inadmissible interval. Splitting an interval into two pieces must give the same
endpoint.
Mathematical Modeling Notes 20 / 22
